test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 01 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, W, X and Y are sitting in a straight line facing north. No one sits to the left of D. Only four people sit between D and C. Only three people sit to the right of Y. X sits to the immediate left of A. W is not an immediate neighbour of Y. Who sits third to the left of W?
solution:
Persons: A, B, C, D, W, X, Y

All face North

Linear arrangement (left → right)

No one sits to the left of D

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81c104c034db594faf9031ab6563129f92041f238bfafd5f0323904ac9062c1a.png] 

Four persons between D and C

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c7966e18912e146269704723b11a4ba867eda88ce077818503e3333a1101fb2.png] 

Three persons to the right of Y

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da180058a8dafd3e7f0110ddb37b2a07f7bfc3116cce8d8feba63445ddd43552.png] 

X sits immediate left of A

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8dd9f128341be3654239547d8871af8f8a87e464bc6ca45e955f99cd74951412.png] 

W not neighbour of Y

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/000c512bad1533c6cfa0804eec02a10c2c1d41eaf83f5aa26b6341057decbb65.png] 

Final arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b310716c2891b276649394fbc35f8ef4a7d2a8c5b0803580dbec2a9de7b31a7f.png] 

**⇒ Y **sits third to the left of W

Hence the right answer is **Option 2.**
